documents.subject: Price Adjustment Notice for RM-AL-A380: Effective Date Correction per Section 4
documents.message:
Dear Marta,

We acknowledge receipt of your price adjustment notice dated 22 September 2026 for RM-AL-A380. As per section 4 of contract VC-2025-014, supplier must notify buyer at least 15 days before the adjustment takes effect. Your notice was received 9 days before the proposed effective date (1 October 2026), which does not meet the contractual lead time. Therefore, the adjustment to 3.23 EUR/kg (per the formula) will apply from the next review period, not from 1 October 2026. Please confirm your acceptance of this correction by 1 October 2026.

Best regards,
Veltra Automotive Purchasing
documents.rationale: Section 4 of VC-2025-014 requires a 15-day written notice for price adjustments. The supplier's notice was received only 9 days before the effective date, so the adjustment can only apply from the next review period. The formula also gives 3.23 EUR/kg, not 3.38 EUR/kg.

documents.subject: Renewal Offer for 2027: Competing Offer from Pacific Latex Sdn. Bhd.
documents.message:
Dear Lim,

Thank you for your renewal offer of 2.45 USD/kg for 2027 under contract VC-2024-040. We have received a qualified offer from Pacific Latex Sdn. Bhd. at 2.05 USD/kg, valid until 20 October 2026. As per section 7 (Renewal), we are free to award the next period to another supplier. Please advise by 15 October 2026 if you are able to match or improve upon this offer; otherwise, we will proceed with alternative sourcing.

Best regards,
Veltra Automotive Purchasing
documents.rationale: Section 7 of VC-2024-040 allows the buyer to switch suppliers at renewal. A qualified alternative offer at 2.05 USD/kg is on the table, so we should request Keystone to match or improve their offer before the deadline.
